reviewMethod: Root inspected all four neutral Blender views and sixteen quarter-cycle poses. Source audit and actual Three.js GLTFLoader CPU roundtrip verified optimized geometry and all clips, within 0.879 mm of source bounds. This is not browser or GPU verification.
notes: Final four neutral views opened and inspected. Earlier pale pigment, long neck, exposed bead eyes, snout cap UV pinching and sharp folded rear tips were corrected.
All sixteen final pose samples opened together in labeled contact sheet. Shoulder roots remain visually seated and front strokes stay marine; no leg stepping.
Swim has paired shoulder downstroke and restrained distal flex; Float and Glide remain subtle; Turn uses asymmetric fin action, yaw and mild bank.
Authored educational anatomical interpretation, not photogrammetry or a museum scan. Generated scale pigment does not reproduce an individual turtle.
Shell, plastron, soft tissue and eyes are intersecting anatomical surfaces, not one watertight sculpt. Deforming roots use explicit blended weights.
Four views and quarter-cycle samples are visual evidence, not exhaustive continuous collision analysis.
Neutral review background has a visible distant studio floor edge at the bottom in low-angle views; studio helpers are excluded from GLB.
Optimized runtime artifact review belongs to the integration owner; this report covers the stable Blender source and raw export.

Decoded optimized desktop GLB was reimported into Blender and rendered: geometry, skin and compressed material pixels inspected. Decompression changed no vertex/animation data; WebP pixels were losslessly converted to PNG solely for Blender review. This is not a browser screenshot.
Root also inspected the decoded optimized mobile export in a neutral Blender render: anatomy, pigment and shell/flipper or limb boundaries remain coherent. This is not a browser screenshot.
